Jane Street offers several software engineering, software development, and AI internships suitable for students, all based in New York:

1. **Software Engineer Internship (May-August)**
   - Department: Technology
   - Description: An educational experience where interns are paired with full-time mentors to work on real-world projects, including high-performance trading systems and programming language design, using OCaml and potentially Python. Top-notch programming skills, intellectual curiosity, and a collaborative spirit are required.
   - URL: https://www.janestreet.com/join-jane-street/position/8599644002/

2. **Machine Learning Engineer Internship (May-August)**
   - Department: Trading, Research, and Machine Learning
   - Description: An educational experience where interns work on real-world ML projects mentored by full-time employees. Interns will gain experience with large-scale GPU clusters (H100/H200/B200s) and apply machine learning to noisy financial data. Requires an undergraduate or PhD student with practical ML experience, strong programming skills, and a collaborative, curious mindset.
   - Salary: $300,000 base
   - URL: https://www.janestreet.com/join-jane-street/position/8611307002/

Google offers several internship opportunities suitable for students in software engineering, software development, and AI/ML fields:

1. **Software Engineering Internship**
   - Available globally for undergraduate, graduate, and PhD students
   - Rolling application dates
   - Focuses on building scalable systems, working with distributed systems, APIs, and cloud architecture
   - Interns work on real-world technical challenges alongside experienced engineers

2. **AI and Machine Learning (ML) Roles**
   - Available for students interested in AI/ML
   - Roles include Applied AI Engineer, ML Infrastructure, GenAI Product, Research Scientist, Research Engineer, ML Compiler, and Agentic AI
   - Opportunities across Google, YouTube, and DeepMind

3. **Related Engineering Internships**
   - **User Experience (UX) Internship** - focused on designing and developing products
   - **Associate Product Manager (APM) Internship** - bridges technical and business domains
   - **Mechanical Engineering Internship** - design and analysis for degree-seeking students
   - **Hardware Engineering Internship** - system design for Electrical Engineering students
